Release PR #119 (`gh pr view 119 --json body,files,title`, `gh pr diff 119`) is generated by Callisto and will publish the next monokl version when the owner merges it. Verify it is safe and accurate: (1) version bump vs the highest consumed changeset (pre-1.0: minor for breaking), Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/CHANGELOG/.callisto/release-decision.json all consistent, tag monokl@0.7.0 exists; (2) every merged user-visible change since 0.7.0 (git log of main since the monokl@0.7.0 tag; merged PRs #112? no: list from `gh pr list --state merged --base main --search 'merged:>=2026-11-16'` and `git log --oneline monokl@0.7.0..origin/main`) has a changeset consumed by this release; flag merged PRs that changed CLI output/flags/public API without one; (3) the CHANGELOG text vs a build of origin/main (`cargo build --release`, one cargo command at a time; network/gh need dangerouslyDisableSandbox): `monokl search --help` flags/defaults (--max-results 20, --min-score 0.3, --snippet-lines 1, --offset, --max-tokens, --timeout), the row columns (rank gone; `relevance` is a percent of the top row; finalScore gone), the `truncated[N]{...}` block, michi 0.10.0, the `where …` Rust signature cut, the `+N more` marker, the prefix-token name match and impl prior, KeptText/one open per file, and the Breaking:/Action: notes: run 5 real queries (TS and Rust) and compare actual output to every claim; flag stale or false statements and missing Breaking/Action notes with concrete replacement wording; (4) `callisto status --check --strict` and `callisto release --dry-run` by exit code if installed; `just verify-release 0.7.0` by exit code. Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, CHANGELOG and release-decision.json (targetVersion 0.8.0, new digest) are consistent. The PR is MERGEABLE, based on origin/main d1c75c6d.

- `cargo tree` shows michi-core v0.10.0.
- No stale or false statements found, and the Breaking and Action notes are complete.
- Not checked: the Rust `where` cut, the `+N more` marker beyond a `+1 more` seen in snippets, the prefix-token name match and impl prior, and KeptText. They are not in this release's changelog (earlier releases), so I did not test them.

- `callisto release --dry-run`: 0.

- `cargo build --release`: 0.
- I did not run `just ci` or nextest.
